$comment: The logo lock's manifest, read by pnpm lint:logo (scripts/lint/logo.mjs). generated: files a generator writes from LOGO in src/lib/logo.ts; a picture carries its sha256 and the LOGO.d hash it was drawn from, which the generator records (pnpm build:logo does; otherwise node scripts/lint/logo.mjs --record <path>). history: files that show a previous mark on purpose, exempt from every rule or from the rules listed; with "symbol" only inside that <symbol> element, and with "count" (rules [9] only) for that many references and no more. A film, poster or contact sheet whose reason is "made before the globe; re-render pending" is labelled as the previous mark wherever the site plays it (src/lib/previous-mark.ts). notLogo: files that look like a logo by name or shape but are not one, exempt from rules 2, 3 and 8. checked: films and pictures looked at frame by frame that show the logo or no mark, each held at the sha256 it was checked at. external: the copies in other repositories, compared by --external as notes only.
